🤤🍯Golden Syrup Bread Bites 

🍞✨ Bread Gulab Jamun Style Sweet

📝 Ingredients (सामग्री)

* Bread slices – 6 🍞
* Doodh – 1/2 cup 🥛
* Sakkar – 1 bowl 🍬
* Pani – 1 bowl 💧
* Kesar – 5-6 strands 🌸
* Ilaichi powder – 1 pinch 🌿
* Tel (deep fry ke liye) – as needed 🛢️

👩‍🍳 Steps (बनाने की विधि)

1. Sabse pehle bread ki kinare kat le 🍞✂️
 First remove the edges of the bread slices 🍞✂️

2. Ab bread ko chhote tukdo me tod kar doodh dal kar soft dough bana le 🥛🤲
 Break bread into pieces, add milk and make a soft dough 🥛🤲

3. Ab is dough se chhote gol ball bana le aur beech me halka cut laga de ⚪🔪
 Make small round balls and give a slight cut in the center ⚪🔪

4. Ab kadhai me tel garam kare aur medium flame par inhe golden hone tak deep fry kare 🔥🍯
 Heat oil and deep fry the balls on medium flame until golden 🔥🍯

5. Dusri taraf ek kadhai me sakkar aur pani dal kar halki thik chasni bana le 🍬💧
 In another pan, prepare a slightly thick sugar syrup with sugar and water 🍬💧

6. Ab chasni me kesar aur ilaichi powder dal kar mix kare 🌸🌿
 Add saffron and cardamom powder into the syrup 🌸🌿

7. Ab tale hue bread balls ko garam chasni me dal kar 5–10 min soak hone de 🍯⏳
 Put the fried balls into warm syrup and let them soak for 5–10 minutes 🍯⏳

8. Ready hai aapka soft aur juicy Bread Gulab Jamun style sweet 😋✨
9.
 Your soft and juicy bread gulab jamun style sweet is ready 😋✨

caption:
Steak Loaded Potato Skins

These are insanely delicious and need to be on your menu!

Recipe
• Coat your potatoes in olive oil and bake at 425F for about 1 hour, until soft.
• Cut the potatoes in half, then scoop out the insides into a bowl.
• Fry the potato skins in neutral oil at 350F until golden brown.
• Add 1/4c @tillamook Butter, 2 cups Cheddar Cheese, ½ C cup milk, ½ cup sour cream, ¼ cup chives, 2 tbsp SPG blend.
• Mix thoroughly then stuff each potato skin until it’s ⅔ full.
• Grill the steak over high heat on the @kamadojoe flipping every 2-3 minutes until it reaches your desired doneness.
• Rest the steak for 10 minutes then slice into bite sized pieces against the grain. 
• Place potato skins back in the oven at 350F for 5 minutes
• Top the potato skins with steak, Chipotle sour cream and garnish with chives.

Steak Marinade
Juice from 1 orange
Juice from 2 limes 
¼ cup olive oil
3 cloves minced garlic 
¼ cup liquid aminos
½ taco seasoning packet

caption:
Easy Dinner Idea😍🔥 Save it✅ (2 servings)

Ingredients:
• 200 g minced beef
• 2 fresh tomatoes
• ½ onion, finely chopped
• 3 garlic cloves, minced
• 100 g cream cheese
• 150 ml tomato sauce
• 300 ml water
• 200 g dry paccheri @pasta_rummo 
• Salt, black pepper, paprika, oregano — to taste
• 40 ml olive oil

Tip: Cut out the firm tomato cores before cooking — it’s much easier to do at the start 😉😁

Instructions:

1️⃣ Heat olive oil in a pan. Add the tomatoes, minced beef, onion, and garlic. Cover and cook over medium heat for about 2 minutes.

2️⃣ Peel off the tomato skins, then stir everything well.

3️⃣ Mix in the cream cheese, spices, and tomato sauce.

4️⃣ Add the uncooked paccheri, pour in 300 ml of water, cover, and let it simmer for around 12 minutes until the pasta is tender.

5️⃣ Finish with freshly chopped parsley and serve.

Rich, creamy, and packed with flavor ☺️ save it ✅#cooking #easyrecipes #recipeideas #pastarecipe #rezepte

🍆🤤Crispy Lehsuni Baingan Fry 🔥 | Street Style Garlic Eggplant
🍆🔥 *Lehsuni Baingan Tawa Fry | Garlic Brinjal Tawa Fry*

🧺 Ingredients | सामग्री

* 2 baingan, medium – 🍆
 *2 medium brinjals*
* 6–7 lehsun, kute hue – 🧄
 *6–7 crushed garlic cloves*
* 1 chammach lal mirch – 🌶️
 *1 spoon red chilli*
* 1 chammach khada dhaniya – 🌿
 *1 spoon coriander seeds*
* Namak, swad anusar – 🧂
 *Salt to taste*
* Tel, tawa fry ke liye – 🫒
 *Oil for tawa frying*

👩‍🍳 Method | बनाने की विधि

1. Sabse pehle baingan ko dono side se thoda kaat kar beech me gehra cut laga do – 🔪
 *First, trim both sides of the brinjals and make a deep slit in the center.*

2. Ab lehsun, lal mirch, khada dhaniya aur namak ko mota mota pees lo – 🌶️🧄
 *Now coarsely grind garlic, red chilli, coriander seeds, and salt.*

3. Is masale ko baingan ke cut wale hisson me aur dono side achhe se laga do – ✋🍆
 *Apply this masala nicely inside the cuts and on both sides of the brinjal.*

4. Tawa garam karo, thoda tel dalo aur baingan ko tave par rakho – 🔥🍳
 *Heat a tawa, add some oil, and place the brinjals on it.*

5. Medium aag par baingan ko dono side se dheere dheere fry karo jab tak golden aur soft na ho jaye – ⏳
 *Fry on medium flame from both sides until golden and soft.*

6. Jab baingan crisp aur andar se ache se pak jaye, gas band kar do – ✨
 *Once the brinjals are crisp outside and well-cooked inside, turn off the flame.*

🍽️ Serving Tip | परोसने का तरीका

* Garma garam *Lehsuni Baingan Tawa Fry* ko roti, dal-chawal ya simple dahi ke sath serve karo – 😋
 *Serve hot Lehsuni Baingan Tawa Fry with roti, dal-rice, or plain curd.*
